title: Vendor Key Leak Puts Data of 238,000 Denver Health Plan Members at Risk
hint: A leaked SquareML access key could have been used to access a database containing personal and health information.

hint: Apple patched 286 vulnerabilities in iOS and macOS 27.2 and brought the fix for an exploited CoreGraphics zero-day to older iPhones.

title: This is Fine: What NetScaler Zero-Days Tell Us About the New Normal
hint: Keep your patch management pipelines primed in case another round of Citrix NetScaler patches get released soon.

hint: Eight max-severity security defects could lead to remote code execution and authentication bypass.

title: Energy giant ENGIE discloses data breach affecting customers
hint: French energy giant ENGIE, one of the world's largest power and natural gas providers, confirmed that attackers stole customer data after breaching a marketing platform used by business partners.…

title: Apple backports CoreGraphics zero-day patches to older iPhones
hint: ​Apple has backported security patches released last month to older iPhones and iPads, addressing a zero-day bug exploited in "extremely sophisticated" targeted attacks on iOS devices.…

title: What happens when security tools go dark before the ransomware
hint: A China-linked ransomware crew disabled the security tools at a critical infrastructure operator before it launched the encryptor. Most security budgets never priced that in.

title: Malicious apps prey on Russians’ anxiety about fuel prices, drone strikes
hint: Cybercriminals are stuffing infostealer malware into bogus apps aimed at tracking gas prices, police activity, drone strikes and other information of concern to average Russians, researchers said.

title: Hackers repeatedly breached suppliers holding UK police data, watchdog finds
hint: His Majesty’s Inspectorate of Constabulary and Fire & Rescue Services says British police data has been breach several times this decade through third-party IT suppliers.

title: CISA warns of PHP bug exploitation attempts, gives federal agencies days to patch
hint: CISA added the widely publicized PHP vulnerabilities to the KEV, but didn't specify what kind of exploitation it was observing.
